symptom: The production Cloudflare Worker reaches the authorized Aurora bridge but catalog reads receive database_operation_failed and fall back to the last accepted D1 generation.
expected_behavior: Authorized bridge reads connect to Aurora and all four public catalog worlds report aws-aurora without degraded fallback.
environment: VII production v728 on 2026-10-29, Cloudflare Worker to API Gateway to Lambda vii-production-database-bridge to Aurora PostgreSQL in il-central-1.

steps: Request a production catalog through the configured primary database path.
Observe the authorized bridge failure and D1 accepted-generation fallback.
reproduction.evidence: Public catalogs remain HTTP 200 through the continuity fallback while the authorized bridge response is database_operation_failed. An unauthenticated direct bridge request returns the Lambda 404 authentication guard, proving API Gateway invokes the function.

observations.observation: RDS-managed master credentials rotate every seven days by default.
The deployed bridge source cached the Secrets Manager value for the full lifetime of a warm Lambda execution environment with no TTL or invalidation.
The bridge previously passed an authenticated Aurora readiness check on 2026-10-22 and the incident was observed after the first default rotation window.

hypotheses.mechanism: A warm Lambda retained the pre-rotation RDS master password after Secrets Manager rotated the managed secret.
hypotheses.prediction: The first connection with a cached password fails with PostgreSQL invalid-password code 28P01, while invalidating the cache, reading the current secret and reconnecting before SQL succeeds.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Deploy the bounded refresh-on-authentication-failure repair and inspect sanitized stage/code telemetry plus live catalog origin.
hypotheses.result: The local causal test proves exactly one secret refresh and reconnect on 28P01 before SQL. Production verification is pending deployment.

hypotheses.mechanism: API Gateway no longer invokes the Lambda or the bearer token is rejected.
hypotheses.prediction: Unauthenticated and authorized calls both fail before the database stage with a gateway error or not_found.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare a direct unauthenticated bridge request with the authorized Worker path.
hypotheses.result: The direct request reaches Lambda and returns its 404 guard; the authorized path proceeds to database_operation_failed, rejecting the gateway and token mechanism.

hypotheses.mechanism: A network path or security-group failure prevents all database connections.
hypotheses.prediction: The failure code is a timeout or connection error and refreshing credentials does not change the outcome.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Preserve non-authentication connection errors without credential retries and inspect the sanitized production code after deployment.
hypotheses.result: Local tests prove network errors remain a single attempt. Production discrimination is pending deployment telemetry.

fix.change: Add a five-minute secret TTL, invalidate and refetch once only on PostgreSQL authentication failure before any SQL begins, preserve generic external errors, and preserve the route-reported data-origin header.
fix.evidence: 15 focused bridge and backend metadata tests pass; production deployment and live verification remain pending.

affected_family: Transactional reads and writes after connection

regression_checks.check: Single pre-SQL retry on invalid-password only
No credential retry on network failure

remaining_unknowns: The exact production PostgreSQL or network error code remains unavailable until the repaired Lambda is deployed or its CloudWatch logs are read.
Live all-world Aurora reads have not yet passed after the repair.
authorization_boundary: User authorized causal repair and production publication. No database data, schema, secrets, permissions, network configuration or supplier records may be changed.
